name: DAVIGS
definition: A decoupled appearance modeling method that mitigates appearance variation-induced floaters and color distortions by transforming rendered images at the image level using 3D consistent features, without compromising rendering speed.
summary: DAVIGS is a plug-and-play method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that decouples global view-dependent appearance variations from local spatial changes using multi-resolution hash grids to mitigate floaters while maintaining real-time rendering speeds.
